Places particles, points and remnants (middle-click: type · wheel: color)

Click / swipe / double-click (nearest Max-activated targets): each touched point or particle is enlarged (it bursts like a nova) or shrunk (it implodes everything near inward) — one random outcome per gesture, 1 Neutron each

Click a Dim Remnant: it is consumed and becomes a stationary DEPTH (bigger for a heavier remnant) — click it again to destroy it; a new one removes whatever it overlaps. Costs Dim every interval while it stands

Click a Bright Remnant: it is consumed and becomes a stationary BALANCE (a square turned like the remnant, bigger for a heavier one) — everything inside freezes (lifespans too), the outside bounces off; click it again to destroy it and let it all move on. A new one removes whatever it overlaps. Costs Bright every interval while it stands

HARMONY (colour) — click / swipe / double-click (nearest Max-activated targets): everything touched (points and particles) takes ONE random new colour effect — each at its own place in that colour's range — 1 each

RHYTHM (motion) — click / swipe / double-click (nearest Max-activated targets): everything touched (particles wake) gets the SAME one random motion — one direction, one speed, one spin (straight, or a big / mid / tight arc; fast or slow) — 1 each
